result.reason: The operative language substantially reaches the preferred position: it establishes a mutual cap equal to the greater of 12 months’ paid-or-payable fees and USD 1,000,000, includes all required uncapped carve-outs, retains the mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and excludes Company’s fee-payment obligations from the cap. The changes are appropriately confined to correcting the cap, mutuality, and carve-outs. Drafting is professional, with only a minor deviation in measuring the 12-month period from the event giving rise to the claim rather than from the claim itself.
